subject.statement: Greg Abel replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO.
disambiguators: replaced Warren Buffett as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman and CEO

summary: As of late 2026, Warren Buffett continued to serve as both chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway; Greg Abel was identified as the successor but had not yet assumed either position.
